title: 72 - Battle
summary: [[character:bill]] tells the defenders at a [[technology:vr|virtual moot]] that cloaking works, but [[character:jacques]] has had time to retrofit only about half his nuclear weapons. Acting on [[character:george-butterworth|Butterworth]]'s advice, Bill coordinates three passes against the [[species:others|Others]], beginning with [[character:andrew]]'s group. The enemy wipes out the second wave with [[technology:h-bomb|fusion weapons]] and exposes the cloaked bombs with a powerful [[technology:suddar|SUDDAR]] burst. Bill guides the surviving bomb into a [[vessel:death-asteroid|Death Asteroid]], but the fleet presses on toward the [[species:pav|Pav]] homeworld and threatens to harvest Sol and Epsilon Eridani afterward. Andrew reports that Jacques died and has a recent differential backup. Bill has already activated the plan to evacuate twenty thousand Pav without asking for volunteers.

introducing.name: Andrew
introducing.description: A Bob who leads a squad in the defense of Delta Pavonis against the [[species:others|Others]]. His group makes the first pass through the enemy armada, losing about half its small units and eight dreadnaughts.
introducing.current_state: He led the first pass against the enemy fleet and reports that Jacques can be restored once a replacement vessel is available.

introducing.name: Death Asteroid
introducing.description: An [[species:others|Others]] warship built around a powerful gamma-ray beam that must recharge between shots. The platforms travel with harvest convoys. Their beams can destroy unshielded craft, while suitably protected vessels can survive some hits.

introducing.name: Battle for Delta Pavonis
introducing.description: Three Bob attack waves fail to halt the [[species:others|Others]] before they reach the Pav system. The second wave is wiped out and [[character:jacques]] dies in the fighting. The fleet continues toward the Pav homeworld with eleven powered carriers and eight powered Death Asteroids.

introducing.name: Fusion bomb
introducing.description: A fusion weapon also known as an H-bomb. The Bobs have plans provided by [[character:george-butterworth|Butterworth]] and can cloak these weapons, though intense SUDDAR can expose them. The [[species:others|Others]] deploy fusion weapons on fast interceptors.

updates.current_state: His attack failed to stop the Others. He has set Jacques's worst-case plan in motion: 20,000 Pav are to be removed from the planet ahead of the fleet, forcibly if needed. He hopes Jacques also collected samples of local life.
He died during his group's attack. His differential lacks only the final few minutes. The Bobs need another vessel to restore him.

updates.state: The Others' fleet is still approaching after surviving the Bobs' interception, with power remaining on eight Death Asteroids and on eleven of the carriers.
The Others are still headed for the Pav homeworld. Bill has initiated a plan to remove twenty thousand inhabitants before the fleet arrives.
